name: GZW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own served title-history page runs an unbroken chain of twelve champions from "The First" Paul Spartan through a late-era Kage — Zachary Sharp, "The Wrestling Franchise" Monarch, "Career Killer" Maxx Pain, Zac Sharp, "Smooth Operator" Billy Bond, Deacon Kane, Magic, Sincere, T-Rex (carried over from the fed's own predecessor, EWO), Firefly, T-Rex again, and Kage among them — none of it dated on the page itself. Two reigns anchor the ledger here: Paul Spartan's founding reign, per that page's own opening entry, and Zion's win over Above Average Josh Reetz at Autumn of Armageddon, the fullest dated PPV card the corpus preserves. A separate roster page elsewhere in the corpus calls Josh Reetz, not Paul Spartan, the promotion's "first-ever GZW World Champion" — a contradiction the surviving record itself does not resolve, recorded here rather than silently picked. A third reign is now structured from the corpus's own Dead Zone PPV card: Crucyfix defeats Zion in the corpus's own first Crucyfixion Match, strapping him to a burning cross after Black Sunshine's own interference. The fed's own separately served "GZW Champions" snapshot page instead lists Zion, not Crucyfix, as the reigning champion at the time of that page's own writing — a further, unresolved contradiction against the corpus's own record, preserved rather than reconciled.

name: GZW Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Three reigns chain across the held record's three structured shows: Sadistic Sam wins the opening reign in a triple-threat submission match at Friday Night Fury #1; Jake Smith dethrones him at Autumn of Armageddon; Blackbird, of the heel stable Black Sunshine, wins it from Jake Smith in a table match at Dead Zone. The fed's own separately served "GZW Champions" snapshot page instead credits the title to The Hammer, who never appears in the held record's structured title matches — a further, undocumented change this record cannot chase and does not invent, preserved as an open contradiction rather than a fourth reign.

name: GZW Deathmatch Championship
epitaph: Jake Smith wins the title's opening reign by first blood over Gargoyle at Friday Night Fury #1; Griz holds it by Autumn of Armageddon, retaining it there over Furykainne and again over DevilTress in a casket match at Dead Zone, with no surviving document recording how the title passed from Smith to Griz. The fed's own separately served "GZW Champions" snapshot page instead credits the title to "The Griffin" rather than Griz — a contradiction that page's own provenance note already records.

name: GZW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Crucyfix and The Fro win the title's opening reign at Friday Night Fury #1 over Madd Dogg and Geno; Gargoyle and Hydro, of the heel stable Black Sunshine, hold it by Autumn of Armageddon and retain it again at Dead Zone, with no surviving document recording how the title passed between the two reigns.

name: GZW United States Championship
epitaph: Big Earl holds the title through Autumn of Armageddon, retaining it there over Madd Dogg, before losing it to Thane Blackout in a five-way ladder match at Dead Zone — the fed's own separately served "GZW Champions" snapshot page independently corroborates Thane Blackout as the reigning champion.

name: GZW People's Championship
epitaph: Attested only by the fed's own separately served "GZW Champions" snapshot page, which lists Anarkyst as holder — no title match, reign start, or reign length survives the held record's three structured shows. Held here results-free rather than invented.
